findings.fix: Restore `simp only [pTransverse_def, Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]` in `pTransverse_pairing` and `simp only [pTransverse_def, Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply, map_sub, map_smul, hf.fixes_p, hf.fixes_q]` in `stabilizer_fixes_pTransverse`.
findings.issue: `pTransverse_pairing` (293-294) and `stabilizer_fixes_pTransverse` (340-341) were converted from `simp only [pTransverse, map_sub, map_smul, ...]` into `rw` chains of 7 and 6 named lemmas. `rw` is positional and order-sensitive, so these now break on any reassociation or rename upstream, where the previous `simp only` with the same lemma set did not. The adaptation to `projOrthogonal` needed only swapping `pTransverse` for `pTransverse_def, Bilin.projOrthogonal_apply` in the existing `simp only`.

findings.evidence: Witness.lean:47 `@[simp] theorem energy_restFrameWit_apply`; `norm_num` runs the default simp set, so lines 57-58 re-request a rewrite that is already applied. Same pattern at line 49, `simp [energy_apply, restFrameWit_n]`, where `restFrameWit_n` is `@[simp]` on line 42.
findings.fix: Drop line 58 and the explicit `[energy_restFrameWit_apply]` arguments on line 57; if the `rw` is in fact load-bearing, drop `@[simp]` from `energy_restFrameWit_apply` instead so the dependency is visible.
findings.issue: `energy_restFrameWit_apply` is `@[simp]` (line 47), so the `rw [energy_restFrameWit_apply, energy_restFrameWit_apply] at h` on line 58 is subsumed by the `norm_num at h` on the next line, and the two `norm_num [energy_restFrameWit_apply]` arguments on line 57 are likewise redundant. The dead steps suggest the proof turns on a rewrite it does not need.

summary: Proofs in the new Frame files are short, readable and free of change/show or defeq tricks; the prior round's findings no longer apply. The remaining issue is that two pre-existing DIS proofs were rewritten from order-insensitive `simp only` into 6-7 step `rw` chains, a robustness regression, plus some dead rewrite steps in the witness file.
